name: Better Icons
description: Lets Claude search 200,000+ real icons across 150+ sets (Lucide, Heroicons, Material and more) instead of hand-drawing SVGs that come out wrong or inconsistent.

name: Make Interfaces Feel Better

name: Anti-AI-Slop Writing

name: No AI Slop
description: Final edit pass: strips 20+ slop patterns, keeps your voice, and lists what it changed

name: Frontend Design
description: Anthropic's official design skill. Makes Claude commit to one bold aesthetic direction (brutalist, editorial, retro-futuristic, luxury and so on) before it writes code, and steers it away from default looks like purple gradients, cream backgrounds and Inter everywhere.

name: UI UX Pro Max
description: A searchable design library: UI styles, color palettes, font pairings, UX rules and chart types, with guidance per tech stack (React, Next.js, Vue, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Flutter and others). Tell it the project type, such as a fintech dashboard, and it produces a full design system.

name: Taste Skill
description: A family of anti-generic frontend skills covering layout, typography, motion and spacing. You pick a variant to lock in one premium look and override Claude's defaults. Can stand in for UI UX Pro Max at step 02.

name: Impeccable
description: One skill with 24 commands and 61 detector rules for AI-generated frontend tells. Commands target typography, layout across breakpoints, UX errors and polish. Built on top of Anthropic's Frontend Design. Can stand in for step 03.

name: Web Interface Guidelines
description: Vercel's official reviewer. Point it at your UI files and it checks them against Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines: accessibility, forms, focus states, performance and consistency. Comes with Vercel's React best-practices skills, which are also installed on your Mac.

name: Interface Design
description: Remembers design decisions (spacing, colors, depth, surfaces) across sessions and enforces them, so your UI stays consistent from one day's work to the next. Made for dashboards, apps, tools and admin panels, not marketing sites.

name: UX Designer Skill
description: Broad UX guidance: WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, interaction and form design, navigation, mobile-first layouts, UI copy, AI interfaces (chat, copilots, agents) and checks for dark patterns.

name: UI/UX Gold Standard
description: Says it packages 28 techniques taken from award-winning (Awwwards) sites plus a design database. Small project, last updated March 2026. Its own install command writes into the UI UX Pro Max folder and would overwrite it, so use the separate folder shown here.

name: Awesome UX Skills
description: A pack of UX research and AI product design skills, such as choosing the right research method for a question. Installs several skills at once through an install.sh script, so read the script first.

name: AccessLint
description: Accessibility testing engine with a CLI, an MCP server and a Claude Code plugin that audits pages for accessibility problems. Your fork is the engine; the Claude plugin itself lives in the separate AccessLint/skills repo.

name: shadcn/ui skill
description: The official shadcn skill. Gives Claude current component docs, project context and examples, so it adds, styles and fixes shadcn components correctly instead of guessing at APIs.

name: Open Design
description: A local-first desktop app and open-source alternative to Claude Design. Your coding agent becomes the design engine and produces prototypes, landing pages, dashboards and slides as real files. It's a separate app, not a skill.

name: Humanizer
description: Second-opinion pass that removes remaining signs of AI-generated writing. Useful on anything public-facing

name: Archify
description: Turns an idea, plan or whole codebase into an interactive HTML diagram you can explore, restyle and share. Describe a system in one sentence, or point it at a repo for a source-backed architecture map, then keep refining: add a step, highlight a path, switch themes.

name: video-use
description: Edit videos by chatting with Claude Code. Drop raw footage in a folder and get final.mp4 back: it cuts filler words and dead air, color grades, adds clean audio fades, burns in subtitles and generates animation overlays (it can use HyperFrames, which you also forked). Needs ffmpeg and an ElevenLabs API key.

name: Claude Certified Architect Study Guide
description: Community study guide for Anthropic's Claude Certified Architect, Foundations exam, in 15 languages with PDF versions. Unofficial. Links to the official course access request page

name: Repolyze
description: Paste a GitHub repo and get AI analysis of code quality, architecture, security and improvement ideas, with data flow diagrams, a repo score and PDF export. Now maintained at OssiumOfficial/Repolyze

name: Maxun
description: No-code web data platform: turn any website into a structured API, then scrape, crawl, search and monitor it. Self-host with Docker Compose

name: cobalt
description: Ad-free media downloader: paste a link to public content and get the file. Use the hosted cobalt.tools or run your own instance

name: VoiceStudio
description: Fully local, open-source alternative to ElevenLabs: voice cloning and design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobooks in 646 languages. Desktop app with a local API and MCP server for agents

name: LinkedIn Agent Skill
description: Eleven Claude skills that write LinkedIn posts, comments, replies, DMs and a weekly plan, score your profile out of 100, and humanize every draft locally. It writes, you post. See the LinkedIn Agent Playbook section

name: Diagram Design
description: Draws polished, static diagrams as one self-contained HTML + SVG file in your brand: architecture maps, sequences, quadrants and 40+ other types, with no drop shadows and no default Mermaid look. Point it at your website once and later diagrams pick up your palette and fonts. Can import draw.io, Mermaid or Excalidraw and export PNG or SVG. Pairs with Archify: use this for clean slides and docs, Archify when people need to click through.

name: Meetily
description: Privacy-first AI meeting note taker for macOS and Windows. Records, transcribes live with Whisper or Parakeet, and summarizes with a local model through Ollama, all on your own machine with no cloud required. A paid PRO tier adds extra features

name: Harvey
description: Autonomous sales agent that runs in a loop on your own machine: finds businesses that fit your ideal customer, reads their sites, writes personalized cold email sequences, handles replies and works toward booking meetings. Runs on your Claude Code (or Codex) subscription instead of an API key, with a local dashboard where you approve every email before it sends. Needs Python 3.11+

name: Chatwoot
description: Open-source customer support desk: live chat, email and other channels in one inbox. A self-hosted alternative to Intercom and Zendesk

name: Cal.diy
description: Community edition of Cal.com for self-hosted scheduling and booking pages. The project recommends it for personal, non-production use

name: OpenProject
description: Open-source project management and a Jira alternative: agile boards, issue tracking, roadmaps, Gantt charts and time tracking. On-premises or cloud

name: OpenWhispr
description: Voice-to-text dictation for macOS, Windows and Linux: press a hotkey, speak, and text appears at your cursor. Runs local speech models (Whisper, Parakeet) or cloud models with your own key. An open alternative to Wispr Flow

name: WeKnora
description: Tencent's open-source knowledge platform: turns a team's documents into searchable RAG, a reasoning agent for multi-step tasks, and a self-maintaining wiki over the same knowledge bases

name: OpenSEO
description: Open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs for keyword research and other SEO work, with an MCP server and skills so Claude Code can drive it. Pay-as-you-go through your own DataForSEO API key

name: OpenHiggsfield
description: Self-hosted studio for AI image and video generation: one prompt bar across 38 models, each with its own settings, and one gallery for every run. Generation uses your own platform key. A different project from the sunnychase open-higgsfield-ai fork you already have

name: anatomy
